diagnosis: The exact Lean channel was installed, but the root-level identity step invoked lean without a local lean-toolchain or configured Elan default.
observed_output: elan 4.2.3; error: no default toolchain configured
resolution: Invoke Lean and Lake explicitly through `elan run leanprover/lean4:v4.32.2` in both hosted jobs; later project commands continue to select lean/lean-toolchain from the lean working directory.
